long_biography.plain_text:
Raised in New Orleans' Old Algiers neighborhood, Gayle Benson built an independent career in interior design and property renovation. She founded Gayle Bird Interiors and handled projects ranging from commercial spaces to the Superdome. Before entering professional sports, she also developed real estate, a clothing business and a designers' showroom.

Benson married Saints owner Tom Benson in 2004 and began working alongside him across the family businesses. After his death, she assumed control of the Saints and Pelicans, then became an active voice in both leagues. Her tenure has included major stadium investment, international-market expansion and committee service, while Benson Capital Partners channels investment toward the Gulf South.

uncertainties.detail: The distinctive Lady Gayle Marie name, contemporaneous launch article naming Gayle Benson, explicit identification of Tom Benson as her husband and Saints owner, and the internal March 2018 relationship start make the upstream match conclusive. Yacht context is used nowhere beyond identity resolution.

The official team biography establishes New Orleans birth and the age sequence in official and Forbes material fixes 1947. The exact January 26 date is supplied by the established Wikipedia biography and is consistent with every age reference, but no accessible primary record publishes the day and month; those two proposals therefore carry high rather than very-high confidence.

Tom Benson created his starting capital through automobile dealerships and banks, then used it to acquire the Saints. Forbes reported by 2012 that most of his wealth came from the Saints and continues to name that franchise as Gayle Benson's wealth source. Sports is therefore used for the principal transferred fortune, while automotive and banking remain documented formative capital sources.

Benson has made substantial operating decisions and franchise investments after succession, supporting Operator. The rise in team valuations cannot be cleanly separated from league-wide appreciation, so the dossier retains Inherited rather than claiming that she personally transformed the fortune enough for Inherited and expanded.

Gayle Bird Interiors, property renovation and related small businesses are independently documented and form an important part of Benson's biography. Available evidence does not show that they generated a fortune comparable with the inherited sports assets, so they do not replace Sports or Inherited in the wealth classifications.

Searches found multiple Gayle Benson LinkedIn and social accounts belonging to nurses, retirees and other namesakes. No official personal LinkedIn, Instagram or standalone personal website was verified. Only the exact Wikipedia page, Forbes profile and authoritative Saints company biography are proposed.

Professional sports ownership, American football, Basketball and Horse racing each meet active semantic contracts through sustained ownership and governance. General philanthropy is not represented by an active approved tag, and narrower cause tags were not added because the record reflects broad multi-cause giving rather than a single overriding public-interest identity.

The succession dispute is mentioned only to explain why inheritance documentation is unusually explicit. Contested accusations are excluded. Forbes's live net-worth estimate and changing franchise values are source context only and do not appear in the biographies or proposals.

Lady Gayle Marie was used solely to establish the exact owner identity. No yacht name, ownership period, specification, charter activity or transaction appears in either biography, any wealth classification, detail proposal or tag rationale.
